title: Unit Event — A Light Drawn Closer — Episode8 Holding Close

meta.Event Outline: Mafuyu has been stuck unable to move forward since coming to stay with Kanade. Her father asks her what happened that day she spoke with her mother, but though she tries, Mafuyu finds herself unable to answer.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
I apologize for the sudden intrusion.
I know I wasn't scheduled to visit until this weekend...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
But I have to ask. Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
No, it's just...
I found a few clinics and hospitals that seemed good, and I wanted to tell Mafuyu about them right away.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Yes, I have a list of all that provide assistance with mental health issues.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: For example, this one is very highly regarded and easily accessible from Ms. Yoisaki's house. I even had a chance to speak to the doctors, and they seemed like nice people.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Would you like to try taking a visit there sometime, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Oh, that's okay if you don't feel comfortable. Also, you can always stop going if it wasn't what you were expecting.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Alright, I'll let them know.
We can discuss making actual appointments at a later time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Were you okay the other day?
That was a tremendous thunderstorm...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I was fine.
Thunder doesn't scare me anymore...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If you believe that there is even the slightest chance that your dad will understand... Then I think you two should talk...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Are you ready to tell me?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I was talking to Mom...
Because I didn't do very well on this one test...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, she said how she'll be taking my phone in order to ensure that I focus on my studies...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I told her that I'd keep doing my best and begged her to not take my phone away. But she wouldn't listen...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So when she tried to take it from me, it slipped out of my hand and fell into the aquarium... That's how it broke.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's my fault for not doing well on that test.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My laptop, my synthesizer and then my phone... She kept taking away everything that mattered to me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade and the others... I thought I was going to be cut off from them...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I thought I was going to lose everything.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I had to do something before it was too late. I had to tell Mom how I really felt...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
It's okay, Mafuyu...
You can tell me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't actually want to become a doctor...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: For the longest time, I thought your goal was to become a doctor...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: It's okay. You don't need to apologize.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I was completely under the impression until now that you were set on becoming a doctor...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: It seemed possible considering your stellar grades. I thought you had a bright future ahead of you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: My misunderstanding caused you to suffer.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I'm sorry for not realizing this sooner...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: If only I paid closer attention to how you were actually doing, then we might've avoided all this...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's not your fault, Dad. It's mine for...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: You should be doing what you want.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I still don't have a full understanding of what's going through your mother's mind. However, I'll be talking to her later about this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
I'm sure she'll come around.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: No matter what happens, I won't turn my back on you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But I get the feeling that your dad is still just as kind as he was back then.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can't wait to show the others later tonight.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Man, I always seem to get so much done whenever I skip school♪ Anyway, now that I've finished, it's time for a little snack.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? Yuki?
Wait, at this time? Why?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh, what if something happened between her and her dad...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <I was able to tell my dad everything.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She's already found a way to move forward.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I want to do the same.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Seriously, grilled squid?
We couldn't have chosen a worse stall to do for the school festival...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: On top of the sauce smelling really gross, our class t-shirt's unbelievably lame... My motivation's totally through the floor...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, Mizuki seemed excited, so I guess I should try to actually participate this time...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Mizuki's class is doing something that sounded fun...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I should check out what they're doing.
Hehe. This should make for a nice surprise.
